title: How India scales: system design talks
description: 10 talks: Hotstar, JioCinema, Flipkart, PhonePe, UPI, Razorpay, Zerodha, Blinkit/Zomato Kafka, IRCTC

items.title: 01 · Gaurav Kamboj: Scaling Hotstar for 25 million concurrent viewers
items.notes: **Start here.** Watch #1 (Hotstar) and #10 (IRCTC) first: high-concurrency video streaming, then transaction locking.

items.title: 02 · Prachi Sharma & Arpit Bhayani: How JioCinema streams IPL to 20 million devices
03 · Ashutosh Agrawal (ex-Chief Architect, JioCinema): Live streaming at world-record scale
04 · Sudhir Reddy: How Flipkart built hybrid cloud for scale
05 · Heads of Engineering, PhonePe: Why PhonePe still bets on data centres
06 · Nikhil Kamath with PhonePe, Razorpay & NPCI: If UPI is free, who pays for it?
07 · Arjun Tomer & Arpit Bhayani: Razorpay's journey to microservices
08 · Kailash Nadh (CTO, Zerodha): 7+ million Postgres tables
09 · Pradeep Khileri: Scaling Kafka at Blinkit and Zomato
10 · Gaurav Sen, interviewed by Keerti Purswani: IRCTC System Design
items.notes:
**Start here** with #1 (Hotstar).

**Think about it:** how would you architect a fault-tolerant system to handle the Tatkal concurrency bottleneck?
